blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense lawyers of former President Rodrigo Duterte are opposing the introduction as evidence two supplemental studies cited by one of the prosecution’s expert witnesses, for lack of substance. According to an Oct. 30 filing released only on Saturday, the defense is urging the Trial Chamber (TC) III to reject the prosecution’s request to admit as evidence additional materials mentioned by witness “P-1400” in a report. The defense, led by British barrister Peter Haynes, noted that the additional reports were done by other professionals who are not on its witness list and merely served as supplements to P-1400’s […]...
